subject: Scope and life cycle of data
notes: Rule: "The mechanism whereby an argument value is passed by reference from an activating runtime element to an activated runtime element establishes a common data item. The activated unit and the activating unit may use a different name to refer to the common data item." (cite.py --check 8.6.7: OK §8.6.7 3)). Code: CallEmitter.ArgCarrierText builds a BY REFERENCE accessor carrier over the caller's storage (§14.2.3 GR8). Probes: CALL BRSUB USING BY REFERENCE A TE(2) GR with formals X Y Z (different names, a subscripted element, a group): A=XXXX T=014101 GR=ZZ006 (--std 2023 and --std 85); FUNCTION BRFN(G2) with USING BY REFERENCE P, ADD 100 TO P: R=106 G2=106; INVOKE O "SETIT" USING BY REFERENCE A with formal Q: A=QQQQ. All three activation kinds share the common data item. Covering test conformance:cases/8.6.7-Sharing-data-items/pb1009_global_linkage_formal: PB1009M passes A/N/R, PB1009C names them X/Y/G, stores are visible in M (M A=XNEW ...). [editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 (CALL BY REFERENCE in every edition; function/method activation 2002+)]
